name: Rudolf von Panzerlied
original_name: ルドルフ・フォン・パンツァーリート
source:
Another "Eleven Master". His true appearance is unknown as he hides it behind a hologram of an 8-bit tank. Despite his strange appearance, he is an earnest teacher.
